description:
What is This Part?
This is the Drive Shaft U-Joint Flange (12mm) PLUS a New Univeral Joint
Fits All 3 Drive Shafts
Flange– See Above Diagram Part #5, #12, #19
Universal Joint– See Above Diagram Part #2, #7, #14
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 2 – U Joint Flange (12mm)
Qty 2 – Universal Joint
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1988 All Models
